class Public {
  constructor() {}
}
class Hidden {
  private constructor() {}
  static create(flag: boolean) {
    const Selected = flag ? Public : Hidden;
    return new Selected();
  }
}
class Restricted {
  protected constructor() {}
}
class Derived extends Restricted {
  constructor() { super(); }
  static create(flag: boolean) {
    const Selected = flag ? Public : Restricted;
    return new Selected();
  }
}
function explicitlyWidened(Selected: typeof Public | typeof Hidden) {
  return new Selected();
}
const reverseWidened = (Selected: typeof Hidden | typeof Public) => new Selected();
class PlainHidden { private constructor() {} }
const publicToHidden: typeof PlainHidden = Public;
const publicToProtected: typeof Restricted = Public;
console.log(
  Hidden.create(false).constructor.name,
  Derived.create(false).constructor.name,
  explicitlyWidened(Hidden).constructor.name,
  reverseWidened(Public).constructor.name,
  publicToHidden.name,
  publicToProtected.name,
);
